business_summary: C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and trade of paper products in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company provides pulping, papermaking, printing, packing, and waste papers. It also duplex offers coated duplex boards, kraftliner, testliner, and corrugated medium products, as well as is involved in the recycling of wasted paper. The company was formerly known as Samson Paper Holdings Limited and changed its name to C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited in October 2022. C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of NCD Investment Holding Limited.
business_summary_ko: C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited는 투자 지주 회사로서 홍콩과 중화인민공화국에서 종이 제품의 제조 및 무역에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 펄프화, 제지, 인쇄, 포장 및 폐지를 제공합니다. 또한 duplex는 코팅된 양면 보드, kraftliner, testliner 및 골판지 제품을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 폐지 재활용에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Samson Paper Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2022년 10월에 C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited는 1965년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited는 NCD Investment Holding Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
